name: ClassMean.eq_top_of_eval_monomial
summary: Pull p back along v ↦ ι∘v to a W-submodule q of W^{Mon}; it suffices that q is everything. By Nakayama it suffices that every W-linear e from W^{Mon}/q to the residue field κ vanishes. The polynomial Σ_γ e(e_γ)x^γ times the reduction d̄ of d vanishes on all of κ^σ (where d̄ ≠ 0, the point lifts to b with d(b) a unit and hp applies) and has degree n + e ≤ |κ|, so it is 0; as d̄ ≠ 0, all e(e_γ) vanish.

steps.claim: Let q be the preimage of p under the ι-semilinear map W^{Monomials σ n} → O^{Monomials σ n}, v ↦ ι∘v (a W-submodule).
steps.lean: let q := p.comap (σ₁₂ := ι) ⟨⟨(ι ∘ ·), by simp⟩, by simp⟩

steps.claim: p = ⊤ follows if q contains every unit vector e_γ (its image is the unit vector of O^{Mon}), i.e. if q = ⊤, which is obtained as follows.
steps.lean:
simpa [q, Pi.single, Function.comp_update, eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem (Pi.basisFun ..)] using
    subsingleton_tensorProduct.1
    ((subsingleton_dual_iff _).1 ((liftBaseChangeEquiv _).subsingleton_congr.1
    (subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun e ↦ (by ext γ; simpa using congrArg (·.coeff γ) ·)
    ((mul_eq_zero_iff_right (by simpa [·] using hb.map (residue W))).1 (((IsHomogeneous.sum univ _ _
    fun γ _ ↦ isHomogeneous_monomial (e (q.mkQ (Pi.single γ 1))) γ.degree_eq).mul (hd.map
    (residue W))).eq_zero_of_forall_eval_eq_zero_of_le_card (by
    simpa [residue_surjective.comp_left.forall, mul_comm (e _),
      Algebra.smul_def _ (e _), or_iff_not_imp_right, ← residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit] using
      fun b h ↦ congr(e $(q.ker_mkQ.ge ((pi_eq_sum_univ' _).subst (hp b h)))))
    ((Cardinal.natCast_toNat_le _).trans' (mod_cast hW)))))))

steps.claim: By Nakayama's lemma over the local ring W, q = ⊤ iff (W^{Mon}/q) ⊗_W κ = 0 (κ the residue field), which holds if its κ-dual is 0 (W^{Mon}/q is finitely generated, as this form of Nakayama's lemma requires).
That dual is Hom_W(W^{Mon}/q, κ); show that every W-linear e : W^{Mon}/q → κ is 0.

e = 0 if the polynomial Σ_γ e(e_γ)·x^γ over κ is 0 (its coefficients are the e(e_γ)); and since d̄ (d reduced mod the maximal ideal) is nonzero (d̄(b̄₀) ≠ 0 because d(b₀) is a unit), it suffices that its product with d̄ is 0.
steps.lean:
(by ext γ; simpa using congrArg (·.coeff γ) ·)
    ((mul_eq_zero_iff_right (by simpa [·] using hb.map (residue W))).1

steps.claim: That product is homogeneous of degree n + e (each x^γ has degree n, d̄ degree e); a homogeneous polynomial of degree at most |κ| vanishing at every point of κ^σ is 0.
steps.lean:
(((IsHomogeneous.sum univ _ _
    fun γ _ ↦ isHomogeneous_monomial (e (q.mkQ (Pi.single γ 1))) γ.degree_eq).mul (hd.map
    (residue W))).eq_zero_of_forall_eval_eq_zero_of_le_card

steps.claim: It vanishes everywhere: write a point as the residue b̄ of b ∈ W^σ; if d̄(b̄) ≠ 0 then d(b) is a unit, so (ι(b^γ))_γ ∈ p by hp, i.e. (b^γ)_γ ∈ q, and Σ_γ e(e_γ)·b̄^γ = e(class of (b^γ)_γ) = 0; if d̄(b̄) = 0 the product vanishes anyway.
steps.lean:
(by
    simpa [residue_surjective.comp_left.forall, mul_comm (e _),
      Algebra.smul_def _ (e _), or_iff_not_imp_right, ← residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit] using
      fun b h ↦ congr(e $(q.ker_mkQ.ge ((pi_eq_sum_univ' _).subst (hp b h)))))

steps.claim: The degree bound: n + e ≤ |κ| by hW (Nat.card is at most the cardinal).
